example_hadith.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'When a woman spends from her husband's earnings without his command, then for him is half of her reward.'

narrators.name: Hammam ibn Munabbih
narrators.full_name: Hammam ibn Munabbih ibn Kamil al-San'ani

chainIssues: Ma'mar uses 'an (عَنْ) which is ambiguous, but he is not known for problematic tadlis

plainChains: Ma'mar -> Hammam ibn Munabbih -> Abu Hurayrah -> Prophet Muhammad ﷺ

potential_issues.issue: Use of 'an (عَنْ) by Ma'mar instead of explicit transmission terms
potential_issues.impact: Minor - Ma'mar is reliable and not known for problematic tadlis, so this doesn't significantly affect authenticity

potential_issues.issue: Hammam ibn Munabbih's Sahifah is well-known and authentic
potential_issues.impact: Positive - This hadith likely comes from the famous Sahifah Hammam ibn Munabbih which is considered highly reliable

example_hadith.arabicText: عَنْ /94 مَعْمَرٍ L7633 /94 ، عَنْ /26 هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهِ L8095 /26 ، قَالَ : /27 سَمِعْتُ /93 أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 ، يَقُولُ : قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : /20 إِذَا أَنْفَقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ كَسْبِ زَوْجِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَمْرِهِ فَلَهُ نِصْفُ أَجْرِهِ
example_hadith.grade: Sahih - This chain is found in Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim through Ma'mar from Hammam ibn Munabbih from Abu Hurayrah
